note: Per-model dictionary: what the module does not publish. Every entry names its source; nothing is guessed. Patterns: '*' matches one path segment (a uuid, an index, a name); a leading '**' matches any number of leading segments. Poll plan: on_change false on the health rows: a measurement is judged per sample (a counter that stopped, a link that is still down), a setting only when it changes.
